name: Minecraft: PowerNukkitX
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: PowerNukkitX, a Minecraft: Bedrock Edition server written in Java, with Nukkit plugins, custom blocks and items, and vanilla features such as redstone and mobs. Installs any release, checked against GitHub's checksums.
startup:
touch pnx.yml; if grep -q "^  enableMetrics:" pnx.yml; then sed -i "s/^  enableMetrics:.*/  enableMetrics: {{BSTATS}}/" pnx.yml; elif grep -q "^misc-settings:" pnx.yml; then sed -i "/^misc-settings:/a\  enableMetrics: {{BSTATS}}" pnx.yml; else printf "misc-settings:
  enableMetrics: %s
" {{BSTATS}} >> pnx.yml; fi; read -r need 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This server needs Java %s or newer, but Java %s is chosen. Choose Java %s or newer in Startup, then start the server again.
", need, have, need; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseZGC -XX:+UseStringDeduplication -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -Djansi.passthrough=true -Dterminal.ansi=true --add-opens java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED --add-opens java.base/java.io=ALL-UNNAMED --add-opens java.base/java.net=ALL-UNNAMED --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED -cp "powernukkitx.jar:libs/*" org.powernukkitx.PowerNukkitX --skip-setup --accept-license --language eng

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: PowerNukkitX. Downloads a PowerNukkitX release from GitHub and
# checks it against the checksum GitHub publishes. Worlds, plugins and
# settings are never touched, and the jar is only replaced once the new one
# has downloaded and checked out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

jar=powernukkitx.jar
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
# The Java version the jar was built for, from its main class's file format.
jar_java() {
    local main major
    main=$(unzip -p "$1" META-INF/MANIFEST.MF | tr -d '\r' | sed -n 's/^Main-Class: *//p' | head -n 1)
    [ -n "$main" ] || { echo 8; return; }
    major=$(unzip -p "$1" "${main//.//}.class" | od -An -j6 -N2 -tu1 | awk '{ print $1 * 256 + $2 }')
    if [ -n "$major" ] && [ "$major" -gt 52 ]; then echo $((major - 44)); else echo 8; fi
}

# gh_release <owner/repo> <tag, or latest> <file>: sets tag and sum (the
# SHA-256 GitHub publishes, or -), through the installer's gh-release
# (GitHub's API has a low anonymous limit). Returns 1 when there's no such
# release or file, 2 when GitHub can't be reached.
gh_release() {
    local repo=$1 want=$2 asset=$3 out assets
    if ! out=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want" 2>&1); then
        case "$out" in *"has no release"* | *"no releases"*) return 1 ;; *) return 2 ;; esac
    fi
    tag=$out
    assets=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag") || return 2
    sum=$(awk -v a="$asset" '$1 == a { print $2; f = 1 } END { exit !f }' <<<"$assets") || return 1
}

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
rc=0; gh_release PowerNukkitX/PowerNukkitX "$want" "$jar" || rc=$?
case $rc in
1) fail "PowerNukkitX has no release $want. Set Version to latest, snapshot, nightly, or a release such as 3.0.6." ;;
2) fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again." ;;
esac

if [ "$sum" != - ] && [ -f "$jar" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$jar" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "PowerNukkitX $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading PowerNukkitX $tag"
    # gh-release replaces the jar only once the new one has arrived and checked out.
    gh-release download PowerNukkitX/PowerNukkitX "$tag" "$jar" "$jar" || fail "The download from GitHub failed or didn't match GitHub's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
fi
java=$(jar_java "$jar")
echo "$java" > .raptor-java
echo "Installed PowerNukkitX $tag. It needs Java $java or newer."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The PowerNukkitX release, such as 3.0.6, latest for the newest one, or snapshot or nightly for a development build. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Usage statistics
variables.description: Send anonymous statistics about the server to bStats.org, where PowerNukkitX's developers see them (true or false).
